epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease the number of hardcoded mock data dependencies in the frontend from 1 to 0
requirements: R1: The frontend DossierSearch component must fetch real document data and report generation requests from /api/v1/dossier endpoints instead of using mock lists.

slices.title: Integrate DossierSearch UI with backend API
slices.jtbd: When implementing the frontend integration for this epic, I want to replace mock lists with HTTP requests to the /api/v1/dossier backend endpoints, so that the user receives real document data and reports.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user interacting with DossierSearch.svelte, When the user searches or clicks to generate a report, Then the component issues HTTP requests to /api/v1/dossier endpoints and displays the returned data.
Given the component is updated, When the frontend unit and E2E tests are run, Then the tests thoroughly verify that real HTTP requests are issued without mocking.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase percentage of real API calls in DossierSearch from 0% to 100%
